Marissa / Ben — forwarding BrightBank. Telemetry points to per-token scheduling jitter on some edge shards in us-west-2. Impact: sustained ~800–1200ms added latency on streaming tails, across multiple connections.

Suggested immediate actions (short-term):
1) Route-level throttling: temporarily cap max_concurrent_streams for BrightBank to 30% below their current peak.
2) Enable prefix KV cache for chat endpoints if not already on (saves ~200–400ms for repeated prompts).
3) Adjust client-side token_batch_size to 1 (disable micro-batching) to avoid bundling-induced tail waits.
4) If acceptable, switch critical sessions to non-streaming (polling) for ~1 hour as a fallback.

Marissa — can you spin up an emergency route throttle and let us know the exact delta? Ben — can you validate whether any hardware maintenance/stragglers are linked to the affected edge pool?

I'll craft a customer note after we confirm the steps.

Thanks,
Dylan
